name: Yoga
description: Guided sequences of poses and controlled breathing to improve mobility, posture and stress control. Suitable for every fitness level.

name: Open gym
description: Free access to the weight and cardio areas to follow your own routine. Staff can answer questions, but there is no instructor-led session.

name: Crossfit
description: Timed circuits that mix lifting, bodyweight movements and short cardio bursts. Every exercise can be scaled to the participant.

name: Zumba
description: Dance workout set to Latin rhythms that raises the heart rate through simple, repeatable choreographies.

name: Spinning
description: Indoor cycling session led by an instructor, alternating climbs, sprints and recovery intervals on stationary bikes.
